sloka: बलं च सुभृतं वीर हृष्टपुष्टमनुद्धतम् ।सम्भाषासम्प्रदानेन रञ्जयस्व नगेत्तम ।। ७.६४.५ ॥
transliteration: balaṁ ca subhṛtaṁ vīra hṛṣṭapuṣṭamanuddhatam ।sambhāṣāsampradānena rañjayasva nagettama ।। 7.64.5 ॥

translations.english: O hero, O best among men, please the well-maintained, cheerful, well-nourished, and disciplined army by engaging in good conversation and bestowing gifts.
